description: TileKernels' TileLang top-k gate as the TileLang kernel family's DeepSeek V4.1 router, from the candidate image's own vLLM tree: routes like DeepSeek's reference (ids identical, weights within the sum's rounding) for the target (384 experts, top 6) and the drafter (128, top 3) at decode and prefill sizes, ties to the lowest expert, image tokens with the vision bias, one image mask per step, and the same experts as vLLM's Triton dsv4_topk.
